title: Aerich Mod
description: Adds a new "Aerich Ore". With this you can craft new items etc..
body: In this mod you can find a new "Aerich Ore". With this you can craft new items like the Aerich Sword, Pickaxe, etc.. The Aerich Armor saves you from every knockback. It also adds a new villager profession, the profession block is the Aerich Chest, which is a light block and works like a normal chest. And sorry that tons of new item names are german ;]
